Messages.Author: François
Messages.Body:
Hello,

When setting the terms of a Disputed Territory, can I choose to give a
Haven to another Methuselah whose all minions already have other havens
on them ?
If I can, I guess the moving Haven is then burned, is it right ?

Can a vampire play Reality Mirror to use a card he does not meet the
non-discipline requirements ?
E.g., can a non-anarch vampire play Reality Mirror to use Diversion ?
Can Dolphin black play Reality Mirror to use Leathery Hide ?
Can Mata Hari play Reality Mirror to use Leathery Hide ?
Can a vampire play Reality Mirror to use a card he could not play due
to "Once each... " restrictions ?
E.g., assuming Louhi has played a Carrion Crows, could she play Reality
Mirror on another Carrion Crows in the opposing Methuselah's ash heap ?

Thank you,

François

Messages.Author: John Flournoy
Messages.Body:
François wrote:
> Hello,
>
>
>
> When setting the terms of a Disputed Territory, can I choose to give a
> Haven to another Methuselah whose all minions already have other havens
> on them ?
> If I can, I guess the moving Haven is then burned, is it right ?

IANLSJ, but I think you are correct here - the targeting requirement of
Disputed Territory is just 'another Methuselah', so he'd gain control,
have noone to legally place it on and it'd burn.

> Can a vampire play Reality Mirror to use a card he does not meet the
> non-discipline requirements ?

Quoting LSJ from
http://groups.google.com/group/rec.games.trading-cards.jyhad/msg/377d3e2d11803287:

"It will not override any requirements (except Discipline
requirements, per card text) - so it also can't be used for the Anarch
combat cards (unless the !Malk has gone Anarch, of course), etc."

Therefore:

> E.g., can a non-anarch vampire play Reality Mirror to use Diversion ?

No.

> Can Dolphin black play Reality Mirror to use Leathery Hide ?

No.

> Can Mata Hari play Reality Mirror to use Leathery Hide ?

Yes - the card picked by Reality Mirror is 'played as if from your
hand', and Mata Hari can play cards from your hand as if she were the
appropriate clan; if Mata Hari were Clan Impersonated to a !Malk she'd
be able to use Leathery Hide, so I don't believe playing the Reality
Mirror locks her into only playing the resultant card as a !Malk
(specifically because Reality Mirror says it's as if from the hand.)

> Can a vampire play Reality Mirror to use a card he could not play due
> to "Once each... " restrictions ?

Nope - again, since reality mirror uses the ability "as if that card
had been played from your hand", that 'once each' would restrict it
from being played (or played as if) a second time.

> E.g., assuming Louhi has played a Carrion Crows, could she play Reality
> Mirror on another Carrion Crows in the opposing Methuselah's ash heap ?

No.

> Thank you,
>
> François

-John Flournoy
